discovery.auth: API key + secret POSTed (form) to https://api.autotrader.co.uk/authenticate for a 15-minute bearer token; credentials issued by Autotrader to qualified integrators

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). Autotrader Connect: documented Vehicles (VRM lookup), Taxonomy, Stock, Valuations and Search APIs for approved retailers/partners.

fields.name: key
fields.help: Autotrader Connect API key (issued after Autotrader qualifies your integration; production and sandbox keys differ); POSTed form-encoded to https://api.autotrader.co.uk/authenticate.

fields.name: secret
fields.help: The matching API secret. Access tokens last 15 minutes and are re-minted on expiry or 401; unused credentials are removed after 90 days.

config_fields.name: advertiser_id
config_fields.help: Autotrader advertiser id your credentials are permitted for (sent as advertiserId on every call, as in all documented examples).

adapter.terms: Autotrader Connect (https://developers.autotrader.co.uk/api): access by agreement with Autotrader; capabilities (Search, Vehicle Taxonomy, Current Valuations) are enabled per integration.

search_listings.note: GET /search (Capability: Search) — filters the stock of your permitted advertisers (advertiserId from config); make/model are Autotrader standard names (standardMake=Ford, standardModel=Focus), location a UK postcode (distance not mapped), prices in GBP, mileage in miles, condition New|Used. pageSize ≤ 200 per the docs. yearOfManufacture (a string), derivative, media and responseMetrics stay in raw.

get_listing.note: GET /search?searchId=<advert searchId>&advertiserId: the documented way to fetch one advert (listing_id = metadata.searchId from search_listings).

decode_vin.note: GET /vehicles?vin=&advertiserId (Capability: Vehicle Taxonomy). 'VIN look ups are supported for a selection of OEMs only'; UK registrations (VRM) use ?registration=, which the vocabulary has no input for. engine is the derivative description; yearOfManufacture (string), generation and the technical data stay in raw.

get_valuation.note: GET /vehicles?vin&valuations=true&odometerReadingMiles (Capability: Current Valuations; mileage in miles is required). low = trade, mid = private, high = retail valuation (GBP); partExchange is in raw. VIN lookups cover selected OEMs only.

not_offered.list_dealers: The Advertisers API is a beta for configured advertisers only, not a public dealer directory.
not_offered.me: No identity endpoint; the token only proves the key/secret pair.

evidence: host api.autotrader.co.uk: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/4 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
